entries.title: Early Schooling: KV Cambay (Classes 1-5)
entries.description: Early schooling at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Cambay (classes 1 to 5). The first classrooms, the first habits of attention.

entries.title: Family Settles in Anand, Gujarat (2002)
entries.description: The family put down roots in Anand, Gujarat. The town that would hold my school years, my college, my first studio, and eventually my company.

entries.title: Secondary School: KV Vallabh Vidyanagar (Classes 6-10)
entries.description: Middle and high school at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Vallabh Vidyanagar (classes 6 to 10).

entries.title: Higher Secondary, Commerce: Angels School, Anand
entries.description: Classes 11 and 12 in the commerce stream at Angels High School, Anand. A business grounding that would later make running a one-person studio feel natural.

entries.title: First Email Ever Sent (2009)
entries.description: My first email ever, subject line 'ur pic', sent to my sister with her photographs attached. Day zero of a digital trail that this entire archive is built on.

entries.title: BBA in Information Technology: SEMCOM (2009)
entries.description: Began a Bachelor of Business Administration in Information Technology at SEMCOM, Vallabh Vidyanagar. The campus that would shape the next decade, from student to visiting faculty.

entries.title: Internship: Anupam Industries, GIDC Anand (SEMCOM, 2010)
entries.description: A second-year internship at Anupam Industries in the GIDC Anand industrial estate. An early, formative look at how real businesses actually run on the factory floor.

entries.title: AIESEC Induction: 14 Oct 2010
entries.description: Inducted into AIESEC on 14 October 2010. The day my structured creative life began, and the start of a decade of design, leadership, and the friendships that would shape my career.

evidence.caption: AIESEC OGX Fair poster: first commercial design

entries.title: First Commercial Design: AIESEC OGX Fair Posters (2010)
entries.description: My first commercial design brief: event posters for the AIESEC Global Internship Youth Fair, made with Kunal Shah in 2010. I installed Photoshop for the first time and worked on pure instinct, the start of a self-taught path into professional graphic design.
entries.notes:
The Brief: Create promotional posters for the AIESEC OGX (Outgoing Global Exchange) Fair in VVN.

The Milestone: First commercial design brief; first time ever installing and using Adobe Photoshop.

entries.title: First T-Shirt Design: AIESEC OGX Fair (2010)
entries.description: Designed my first-ever t-shirt, the front graphic for an AIESEC OGX Fair tee. An early step from screen design into things people could actually wear.

entries.title: VP Communications: AIESEC Vidyanagar (2011)
entries.description: Led the communications strategy and visual identity for AIESEC Vidyanagar. In this core officer role, I managed the end-to-end communications function: designing promotional posters, driving targeted recruitment campaigns, and building comprehensive branding for large-scale conferences.

entries.title: First Paid Photoshoot: Nail Salon, Bandra Mumbai (2011)
entries.description: My first paid photography commission. After a chance meeting at a Mumbai coffee shop, I was hired to shoot a commercial set for a boutique nail salon in Bandra, the start of my commercial career.

entries.title: First College Ad Film: Festival-Awarded (2012)
entries.description: Directed and shot a student advertising film at SEMCOM in 2012. The film won at the college's ad-film competition.

entries.title: Visiting Card Design: Shril Patel (2012)
entries.description: A clean visiting-card design commission. Small in scope, but part of the steady early freelance work that taught me to turn a brief around fast and keep a client happy.

entries.title: Elected Local Committee Coordinator: AIESEC Vidyanagar (2012)
entries.description: Elected Local Committee Coordinator for AIESEC Vidyanagar, the top role in the chapter, leading its expansion across VVN and reporting to the Baroda leadership. My first taste of running an organisation rather than just a project.

entries.title: Conference Lead: JNC 2012 & GoGujarat (AIESEC)
entries.description: Led the local committee through JNC 2012 and the GoGujarat initiative, coordinating delegates, branding, and logistics across one of AIESEC's busiest conference seasons.

entries.title: First Short Films: Mithibai Kshitij Festival, Mumbai (2012)
entries.description: Represented SEMCOM at the Mithibai Kshitij student festival in Mumbai with two original short films, made with Parth Brahmbhatt. My first films screened to a festival audience, the moment cinema hooked me.

entries.title: First Freelance Client: Greenopia (2012)
entries.description: My first official freelance client. A one-day Facebook cover-art brief for Greenopia (Hrishit / Nilkanth Ray) grew into an ongoing engagement across the rest of 2012, the project that started my professional career.
entries.notes:
Deliverable: Custom Facebook Cover Art and digital social media assets.

Significance: First official paid client, demonstrating early capabilities in rapid delivery (24-hour turnaround) and client retention.

entries.title: Graduates BBA (IT): SEMCOM (2013)
entries.description: Graduated with a BBA in Information Technology from SEMCOM. The formal close of my student years and the runway into full-time creative work.

entries.title: NID Entrance Prep: Bhanwar Rathod Academy (2013)
entries.description: A year of preparation for the National Institute of Design at Bhanwar Rathod's academy. The entrance didn't take, but the discipline of building a portfolio and thinking in design fundamentals stayed with me for good.

entries.title: Freelance Wedding Photography: Gujarat (since 2014)
entries.description: Freelance wedding photography across Gujarat from 2014 onward, candid storytelling, environmental portraiture, and high-stakes event coverage for a wide range of clients.

entries.title: Destination Wedding Shoot: Mathura, UP (2014)
entries.description: Destination wedding shoot in Mathura, UP, booked through an Indian Oil connection, documenting Kumar Jaivardhan's wedding in an unfamiliar city and cultural rhythm (2014).

entries.title: Jepoor: Jaipur Travel Documentary (Director, 2014)
entries.description: Directed and shot Jepoor, an independent travel documentary about Jaipur's streets, architecture and cultural life. I handled location research, cinematography and the visual direction.

entries.title: Photography Competition Wins: State & National (2014)
entries.description: Several state- and national-level photography competition wins during my college years, the formal start of my trajectory as a photographer.

entries.title: Pep & Joss Corporate Film: Director & Cinematographer (2014)
entries.description: Director and cinematographer for Pep & Joss, a corporate film shot on the factory floor at GIDC Anand. Turned industrial machinery and the workforce's rhythm into a visual story; the film still runs online.

entries.title: Team Lead, Design: TGES/Schoogle, Ahmedabad (2014)
entries.description: Joined Ahmedabad ed-tech startup TGES-Schoogle as Team Lead, Design, my first move from solo creative to managing a three-designer team across creative direction and cross-department delivery.
entries.evidenceDetail: Confirmed by user; emails under tges-schoogle domain
entries.notes:
The Role: First official, paid management position.

The Industry: In-house ed-tech (TGES-Schoogle based in Ahmedabad).

Key Responsibilities: Managing a 3-person design team and coordinating cross-departmental creative requirements.

entries.title: Chhello Divas: Unit Stills & BTS
entries.description: Unit Still Photographer and BTS videographer on Krishnadev Yagnik's Gujarati cult classic Chhello Divas (2015) — a theatrically released feature with roughly 539K YouTube views to its name, and the most-seen credit of my early film career.

entries.title: Sameer (Feature Film): Unit Stills & BTS (2015)
entries.description: Shot unit stills and behind-the-scenes coverage for Nomad Movies' feature film Sameer in 2015. The work created production documentation and promotional imagery for my second feature-film assignment that year.

entries.title: First Wedding Commission: Niyati Patel (2015)
entries.description: My first documented wedding commission, Niyati Patel's celebration, archived as the 'Payal Di Shoot'. The shoot that set the baseline for over a decade of wedding photography across Gujarat.

entries.title: Chhello Divas Releases: Gujarati Cult Classic (2015)
entries.description: The public release of Chhello Divas on 20 November 2015, the Gujarati comedy that became a genuine cult classic. My behind-the-scenes stills and BTS footage went on to gather well over half a million combined views on YouTube, making it the most-seen and most-cherished credit of my early film career.

entries.title: Art Director: Patel vs Patrik (Feature, 2016)
entries.description: Led art direction for Dhwani Gautam Films' unreleased feature Patel vs Patrik in 2016, covering set design, styling and scenic layouts. Production stopped before release, but it was my first feature-length art-direction credit.

entries.title: First Cinematography Showreel (2016)
entries.description: Compiled and published the first formal cinematography showreel, establishing a centralized portfolio of early film and video work. The reel serves as the baseline technical index for subsequent commercial, narrative, and corporate video productions.

entries.title: Pondicherry Travel Film: Director & Cinematographer (2016)
entries.description: Directed and shot an independent Pondicherry travel film in 2016, shaping the concept, framing, camera work and visual treatment.

entries.title: Visiting Faculty: SEMCOM (since 2016)
entries.description: Began teaching as Visiting Faculty at SEMCOM in 2016, returning to my own college to mentor students in advertising, film, and design production. The first batch covered digital media marketing, cinematography, film editing, and blockchain, and that year's student ad-making competition produced notably strong work. A relationship with the campus that has now run for the better part of a decade.

entries.title: Home Halt: Brand Identity & Website (2016)
entries.description: Brand identity and website development for Home Halt, delivered as a single engagement covering the logo, visual language, and web presence.

entries.title: Swachh Bharat Abhiyan: Documentary Photography (Govt of India, 2016)
entries.description: Photographic documentation of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan on-ground work for the Government of India.

entries.title: Passport (Feature Film): Unit Stills & BTS (2016)
entries.description: Unit stills and behind-the-scenes coverage on the set of Passport, documenting the production as it was shot.

entries.title: Europe Photography Trip: Italy, France, Netherlands, Belgium (2017)
entries.description: An immersive photographic journey across Europe. Over the course of this trip through Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Belgium, I focused on capturing the distinct character of each region. From the historic streets of Rome and the Vatican to the Eiffel Tower and the canals of Amsterdam, this project was an exploration of European life and architecture through the lens.

entries.title: Rescues Diana: Ahmedabad (2017)
entries.description: Rescued Diana from the streets of Ahmedabad with Nahush. Eleven years of companionship that have outlasted most jobs, cities, and plans.

entries.title: Co-founds Pixelate: Blockchain Photo Startup (2017)
entries.description: Co-founded Pixelate with Ronak P Amin and Pranav Burnwal, an AMM for camera-sensor photographs ('Pixel Tokens'). The token reached whitepaper stage but never shipped.

evidence.caption: Startup Weekend Bangalore win with the Pixelate team

entries.title: Abad Bread: Corporate Films (Director/DP, 2017)
entries.description: Directed and shot two corporate films for Abad Bread through Letsarc Media in 2017. Both finished films are linked in the archive.

entries.title: Armoise Hotel Ad: Director & Cinematographer (2017)
entries.description: Directed and shot a hotel advertisement for Armoise through Letsarc Media in 2017. The completed commercial is linked in the archive.

entries.title: Wins Startup Weekend Bangalore: 54-Hour Challenge (2017)
entries.description: Won the 54-hour Startup Weekend Bangalore challenge with the Pixelate team. A sleepless, high-pressure sprint from idea to pitch that validated the blockchain direction we would chase for the next few years.

entries.title: Dell TVC: Art Director, "Ek Behtar Kal Ka Aarambh" (2017)
entries.description: Art-directed Dell's "Ek Behtar Kal Ka Aarambh" television commercial in 2017, shaping the set and frame-level visual language for production.

entries.title: Art Director: MAP Oil National TVC (2017)
entries.description: Art-directed a national television commercial for MAP Premium Edible Oils in 2017, leading set design and the visual treatment through production. It was my first national TVC credit.

entries.title: Wedding Films & Photography: Cassidix Media Works (2018-2025)
entries.description: Shot wedding films and photography with Cassidix Media Works from 2018 to 2025, covering multiple celebrations across an eight-year collaboration. Selected films and the Cassidix portfolio are linked in the archive.

entries.title: Drafts the Pixelate Whitepaper (2018)
entries.description: Drafted the Pixelate whitepaper, translating a sprawling set of ideas about decentralised creative ownership into a structured technical and economic document. The blueprint that anchored the venture.

entries.title: Tosha Wedding Film: Cinematographer & Editor (2018)
entries.description: Cinematographer and editor on Tosha's wedding film in Ankleshwar, Gujarat (2018). Cut as a cinematic 'Bride Book' built around unscripted moments rather than standard event documentation.

entries.title: Certified Blockchain Expert: Blockchain Council (2018)
entries.description: Earned formal certification as a Blockchain Expert, putting rigorous foundations under the self-taught web3 work and giving the Pixelate venture real technical credibility.

entries.title: Tarikshir Book Launch: Marketing Lead, Dubai (2018)
entries.description: Marketing lead and digital creative for Khayaal Patel's debut novel Tarikshir. Ran the international launch in Dubai (Starmark, 2018) and managed the author's ongoing personal brand, social aesthetic, content, and audience. My first international travel.
entries.notes:
Scope: International event promotion & ongoing personal brand management.

The Launch: Managed on-ground marketing and social buzz for the Tarikshir release in Dubai (my first international work trip!).

The Brand: Acted as creative lead for Khayaal’s ongoing digital persona, handling daily content creation, grid curation, and community building.

entries.title: Music Video: The Other Woman ft. Iti, Director & DP (2019)
entries.description: Directed and shot the independent music video The Other Woman featuring Iti in 2019, owning the visual concept, framing and cinematography.

entries.title: Guest Lecturer: CVM College of Fine Arts (2019)
entries.description: Invited to guest-lecture at CVM College of Fine Arts, sharing working-industry practice in film and design with fine-arts students and bridging the gap between the classroom and live commercial work.

entries.title: Jadi Duty: Ayurvedic Brand Identity & Packaging (2020)
entries.description: Brand identity and packaging system for Jadi Duty, an Ayurvedic wellness brand (Ashwagandha, Moringa, Giloy capsules). An earth-toned, apothecary-inspired grid across bottle wraps and boxes, traditional supplements positioned for a modern shelf.
entries.notes:
Scope: Core Brand Identity & Packaging Design.

Deliverables: Custom geometric iconography, color palette, bottle wrap labels, and outer box layouts for three distinct SKU lines (Ashwagandha, Moringa, and Giloy).

Design Strategy: Utilizing a modular, grid-based layout to balance regulatory supplement information with a clean, modern aesthetic.

entries.title: Research Associate: OCTO Advisory (2020)
entries.description: Joined OCTO Advisory as a Research Associate, running market analysis on the collaboration-software landscape. A disciplined stretch of structured research and synthesis alongside the creative practice.

entries.title: Essay: The Human Eye & Its Collective Visual Knowledge (2020)
entries.description: Researched and wrote 'The Human Eye and its Collective Visual Knowledge', an essay drawing my photography practice and my curiosity about perception into a single line of thought.

entries.title: Gujarat Tourism Ad Films: Art Director (2020)
entries.description: Served as Art Director and Production Associate for a series of state-level commercial ad films commissioned by Gujarat Tourism. Collaborated with Talk of the Town Media to oversee scenic design, spatial layouts, and on-ground production logistics, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.

entries.title: NEAR Protocol Accelerator: Pixelate Co-founder (2021)
entries.description: Joined the NEAR Protocol accelerator bootcamp as a co-founder, formalising the Pixelate venture inside a serious web3 ecosystem and learning to build and pitch on a global stage.

entries.title: $15,000 NEAR Fast Grant: 14 Oct 2021
entries.description: The $15,000 NEAR Fast Grant landed on 14 October 2021, exactly eleven years to the day after my AIESEC induction. The single largest grant of my career, and a quiet, almost cinematic rhyme between where I started and where the work had carried me.

entries.title: Workshop on Wheels (WOW): Brand Identity (2022)
entries.description: Brand identity for WOW (Workshop on Wheels), an at-home automotive-servicing concept. Designed the logo and extended the visual language across print and digital.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary/Secondary Logo, Website UI/UX, Print Collateral (Business cards, service menus).

Specialized Assets: Vehicle wrap/livery design (if applicable: a huge selling point for mobile businesses).

Key Challenge/Goal: Balancing the rugged, trustworthy feel of an automotive garage with the sleek, modern convenience of an app-like on-demand service.

entries.title: Silver Dragon: Restaurant Rebrand (2022)
entries.description: Rebrand for Silver Dragon, a 25-year-old Indo-Chinese restaurant in Vallabh Vidyanagar, under Haus of Pixels. New primary logo and color palette, modernised without losing its legacy.
entries.notes:
Scope: Full visual identity overhaul for a 25-year-old legacy establishment.

Deliverables: Primary & Secondary Logos, Comprehensive Brand Guidelines (Logo Guideline), Brand Color Palette, and Typography System.

Key Challenge/Goal: Modernizing the visual aesthetic of a highly established local restaurant without alienating its multi-generational customer base.

entries.title: MK Engineering Works: Industrial Brand Identity (2022)
entries.description: Brand identity for MK Engineering Works, a manufacturer of industrial and defence parts. A precise, geometric logo and high-visibility palette built around the workshop's technical strength.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary logo design, brand color palette, and corporate stationery (such as the invoice templates visible in your mockup).

Key Challenge/Goal: Modernizing heavy industrial branding while maintaining a sense of durability, extreme precision, and trust suitable for defense sector clients.

entries.title: Incorporates Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd (2022)
entries.org: Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd
entries.description: Incorporated Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd in Anand (CIN U72900GJ2022OPC131119), giving the practice a legal home. The moment a freelance creative life became an actual company with my name as sole owner-director.
entries.clientCanonical: Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd

entries.title: Volunteer Event Promoter: Arahantas, Himachal (2022)
entries.description: A deliberate detour into the Himalayas. Over a five-month stay in Himachal Pradesh, I spent three months volunteering at Arahantas, trading commercial commissions for grassroots action. I managed weekend events, engaged with the community face-to-face, and handled their daily promotional needs: whipping up event posters and social media posts on the fly. This immersive, hands-on chapter served as a grounding prelude to my later brand commissions for the space.

entries.title: My Village Tea: Packaging & Branding, Kangra (2022)
entries.description: Branding and packaging design for My Village Tea, a Kangra (Himachal) green-tea brand, the work centred on the pack.

entries.title: House of Glam: Beauty Brand Identity (2023)
entries.description: Brand identity for House of Glam, a beauty salon. A classic serif monogram on a textured-gold motif, carried across the brand's touchpoints for a premium feel.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary and secondary logos, brand color palette, typography selection, and brand guidelines.

Key Challenge/Goal: Elevating a local salon into a premium, high-end beauty destination through sophisticated visual communication.

entries.title: Cross.pet: Pet E-commerce Brand Identity (For Sale, 2023)
entries.description: Brand identity for cross.pet, a modern online pet store (available for sale). Anchored by an oversized logo mark that scales from e-commerce UI to packaging and merchandise.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary logo design, brand color palette, typography selection, and packaging/merchandise design.

Key Challenge/Goal: Creating a distinct, memorable mark that works just as effectively as a digital avatar or website header as it does on physical shipping materials.

entries.title: Arahantas Yoga: Brand Identity & Photography (2023)
entries.description: Brand identity and photography for Arahantas Yoga in Dharamkot. Shot the studio's daily rhythm and designed social content and event posters around its quiet energy.

entries.title: Yogesh Khaman: LED Food Commercial (Director/DP, 2023)
entries.description: Director and photographer for Yogesh Khaman's promotional food content, built for high-brightness LED displays. Bold color separation, macro texture, and controlled lighting to make the product read on screen.
entries.notes:
30+ year old khaman shop. LED screen content for new outlet
Conducted full product photoshoot and then turned the photos repository into multiple seasonal slideshow for LED screen

entries.title: Portfolio 2023: 24-Module Behance Anthology
entries.description: A curated anthology of my creative journey up to 2023. This massive 24-module Behance presentation serves as a visual archive, bringing together diverse brand identities, visual systems, and personal milestones into a single, cohesive narrative that reflects my evolution as a designer.
entries.notes:
Format: 24-module digital compendium published on Behance.

Scope: Curating, formatting, and presenting a multi-year archive of commercial and personal design work.

Milestone: Establishing a unified visual language for my own personal brand and creative identity.

entries.title: Serena Nanawati Music Video: Art Director & DP (2023)
entries.description: Art Director and Cinematographer on Serena Nanawati's music video (2023), shot design, lighting, and camera movement translating the track into an atmospheric visual.

entries.title: Director & Producer: Buddy Tales Animated Series (Shivanata, 2023–2025)
entries.description: Director and Producer of the Buddy Tales animated mini-series with Savan Barot, under Shivanata Production LLP, leading two animators and a background artist on a remote pipeline. Began as a client contract in Dec 2023 and ran through to the 10-minute pilot, wrapping 24 Dec 2025.

entries.title: Singapore & Malaysia Travel Film: Flamingo Travels (2023)
entries.description: Cinematographer for Flamingo Travels' multi-country campaign across Singapore and Malaysia, a 10-trip shoot covering the streetscapes and skylines of both countries (2023). A bucket-list international project.
entries.evidenceDetail: "Top 5 things to do in Singapore" + "Highlights Travel Video Malaysia & Singapore" Jun 2024

entries.title: Mankind Pharma: Internal Corporate Film (Director/Editor, 2024)
entries.description: Director and editor on an internal corporate film for Mankind Pharma, paced and cut to give internal brand messaging the same craft as a broadcast ad (₹45,000).

entries.title: Generative AI Toolstack: 15+ Production Tools
entries.description: Current and hands-on across the production GenAI stack: ChatGPT (GPT, Image, Projects, Codex), Claude (LLM, Claude Code, Projects, Design), Freepik / Magnific (image, video, template and audio gen; 20+ months paid), ElevenLabs (TTS, voice cloning), Suno AI (music + SFX), Higgsfield (video, cinema, image, UGC), ComfyUI (self-hosted pipelines), OpenCode (self-hosted code gen), and LM Studio (self-hosted LLMs).

entries.title: Co-founds KindHealth: Health-Tech Venture (2024)
entries.description: The opening move on KindHealth as co-founder, setting up the structure and groundwork for a health-tech venture and beginning to shape what the product and brand could become.

entries.title: KindHealth: Financial Model (2024)
entries.description: Built out the KindHealth financial model, pressure-testing the venture's economics and turning an early-stage idea into numbers a co-founding team could actually plan and raise against.

entries.title: Its a Baby! Studios: Full Brand Identity (2024)
entries.description: Complete visual identity for Its A Baby! Studios, Vadodara, my largest single-client deliverable of 2024. Brand book, six brochures, stationery, custom apparel, and large-format hoardings across print and digital.
entries.notes:
Scope: End-to-end brand identity rollout.

Print & Digital Deliverables: Brand Guidelines, Brochures (x6), Stationery (Letterhead, Business Cards, Invoice Templates), Apparel (Tees), and Large Format Displays (Banners, Hoardings).

Key Challenge/Achievement: Maintaining consistent brand colors, typography, and playful character elements across highly varied print and digital formats.

entries.title: Health-Tech Co-founding Stint: Riga, Latvia (2024)
entries.description: A health-tech co-founding stint in Riga, Latvia (2024), a short, sharp chapter abroad that sharpened my read on where, and with whom, to build next.

entries.title: Pixelate Winds Down (2024)
entries.description: Pixelate wound down after years of building, granting, and pitching, closing one chapter and clearing the ground for everything that came after.

entries.title: Energy-Policy Analyst (Volunteer): Auroville Consulting (2024)
entries.description: Volunteered with Auroville's consulting community, accepted into an energy-policy analyst track among a wave of roles I applied to in a single decisive week. A deliberate reset toward purpose-led work after the Pixelate chapter closed.

entries.title: Visual Design Consultant: Rabble Labs & BuidlersTribe (2024)
entries.description: Visual Design Consultant for Rabble Labs and BuidlersTribe, working with the Product, Growth, and Business Development teams. Built brand identities for Rabble Labs and Scribble and turned them into scalable design systems, templates, and assets.
entries.notes:
Brand & UI: Brand Identities (Rabble Labs, Scribble), Product Design, Graphic Layouts, and Custom Illustrations.

Marketing & Content: Social Media Templates, Audio-Visual Content, Infographics, and Generative AI Content.

Business Strategy: Investor Pitch Decks and Proposal Documents.

entries.title: Kalarigram Mahashivratri: Travel Film (Director/Editor, 2025)
entries.description: Self-initiated travel film covering the Mahashivratri celebration at Kalarigram, shot and edited solo.

entries.title: Conscious Cafe: Menu Design, Pondicherry (2025)
entries.description: Menu design for Conscious Cafe, a well-loved spot in Pondicherry. Clean visual hierarchy and typography across a broad menu, house-made kombuchas, specialty coffees, and floral teas.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Print-ready menu layouts, digital menu adaptations, typography selection, and layout strategy.

Key Challenge/Goal: Balancing a large variety of categories (kombucha, slow juices, floral teas) without cluttering the page.

entries.title: Petved: Pet Nutrition Brand & Packaging (2025)
entries.description: Brand identity and capsule-packaging design for Petved Nutritions, a pet-supplement brand (2025).

entries.title: Green Silk Road: Map Portal (Tech Contractor, 2025)
entries.description: Ongoing tech-contracting on the Green Silk Road map portal, handling database support and the data plumbing behind an interactive mapping product.

entries.title: Surat Municipal Corporation: 3 Corporate Films (DP, 2026)
entries.description: Worked as cinematographer and motion-graphics designer on three Surat Municipal Corporation corporate films through Letsarc Media in 2026. All three finished films are linked in the archive.
